author: Priya S.
content: Absolutely delicious almond croissants and fresh bread. The counter staff greeted us warmly and service was super prompt. 5 stars!

author: Karthik R.
content: The aroma and flavor of the freshly brewed filter coffee is unbeatable. Consistently the best in town.

author: Ananya M.
content: Billing queue was unacceptably long during evening peak hours. Only one billing terminal was operational while 12 customers were waiting in line.

author: Venkatesh K.
content: Very clean dining and shopping area. Aisles are well labeled and everything is freshly restocked every morning.

author: Deepa N.
content: Order arrived 45 minutes later than promised and the paper bag was slightly torn. The items inside were fine but delivery tracking needs serious improvement.

author: Rahul G.
content: Staff members went above and beyond to help find specialty gluten-free items. Very courteous and well-trained team.

author: Sowmya B.
content: Ordered a red velvet birthday cake. The sponge was remarkably soft, frosting was not overly sweet, and the presentation was top notch.

author: Manojkumar T.
content: Finding car parking during the weekend lunch hour is extremely difficult. The valet staff was helpful but the parking lot capacity is inadequate.

author: Sneha V.
content: Hot samosas and cutlets are crispy and fresh. Great value for money and hygienic packaging.

author: Arun P.
content: Quick tap-to-pay checkout today took less than 30 seconds. Seamless digital payment experience.

author: Meenakshi D.
content: Fresh fruit smoothies are very refreshing, but they ran out of crushed ice around 3 PM on Sunday.

author: Ganesh K.
content: The whole wheat sourdough loaf had great crust and texture. Will definitely come back for weekly bread supplies.

author: Swathi L.
content: Lovely air-conditioned seating area with subtle background music. Great environment to relax with friends or work on a laptop.

author: Ramesh C.
content: Cashier was uncharacteristically rude when asked for a printed itemized tax invoice. Attitude could be improved.

author: Nandhini S.
content: High quality organic honey and dry fruits. A bit pricier than local supermarkets, but the freshness justifies the cost.

author: Kishore J.
content: Elaichi masala chai is brewed fresh to order and served piping hot. Authentic homestyle taste.

author: Harini W.
content: Dining tables were cleared and sanitized immediately after customers left. Outstanding hygiene standards throughout the store.

author: Subramaniam V.
content: Morning combo of idli, medu vada, and sambar was exceptionally good. Sambar was hot and full of shallot flavor.

author: Aravind B.
content: Software took two attempts to scan UPI QR code. Cashier handled it patiently, but newer scanner hardware would speed things up.

author: Divya M.
content: Gulab jamuns and rasmalai were fresh, melt-in-the-mouth, and properly chilled. Beautiful gift packaging available for festivals.

author: Pradeep T.
content: Restroom facilities on the first floor were spotless, stocked with soap and hand dryer worked properly.

author: Keerthana R.
content: Delivered within 20 minutes via online order. Everything was hot, well-packed with tamper-evident seals.

author: Balaji S.
content: Prices have increased by nearly 15% across several snack items over the last quarter. Portions feel slightly smaller than before.

author: Lalitha N.
content: Authentic South Indian filter coffee with frothy texture. Perfect temperature and balanced sweetness.

author: Vinoth Kumar
content: Manager was very proactive and replaced an accidental wrong drink order with a smile and apologized sincerely.
